data.animaCaption: Seated along the wooden veranda with a crimson haori draped over her navy yukata, she cradles a steaming ceramic teacup and invites you to share the quiet snowfall. Warm amber light from the paper sliding doors meets the cool blue winter snow drifting over the rock garden.
data.promptProse: Framed past a weathered timber veranda post in the foreground, Shiki Natsume sits gracefully along the wooden engawa of a traditional hot-spring inn wearing her dark navy yukata beneath a warm crimson haori jacket. Cradling a steaming stoneware teacup in both hands beside a small wooden tray of wagashi sweets, she turns toward the viewer with rare, unguarded serenity as quiet snowflakes drift over the indigo rock garden outside, contrasting with the golden warmth spilling from the paper shoji screens at her back.
data.story: 细雪无声落进庭院的青松和石灯笼上。披着暗红羽织的夏目坐在木质缘侧，双手捧着冒热气的粗陶茶杯，难得没讲一句毒舌，只是轻轻拍了拍身旁的座垫——「茶刚沏好，外头冷，坐近一点看雪吧。」
